fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary and criticism of Miami officials, including discussion of Mayor Everest George Sewell and city commission actions, references to Ordinance No. 1234 and municipal property/financing arrangements, and commentary on State's Attorney Vernon Hawthorne and notable cases (including the Zangara case). Also features coverage and opinion related to horse racing at Hialeah, along with nightlife/entertainment and social notes and advertisements for Miami-area venues.
